what: Authorized schematic deltas of the A7 controller against the reviewed baseline. Checked by scripts/native_gate/delta.py: every observed delta must match an entry and every entry must match an observed delta. Pins of a component_replaced ref leave the connectivity comparison and are covered by the behavioral interface assertions instead.

baseline.label: A5 controller XML netlist; the native infrastructure run shows a fresh KiCad 10.0.8 export of the A5 schematic equals it with no delta

review.by: independent electrical reviewer (separate Claude thread, not the author of this change)
review.scope: schematic/netlist delta: role map pin identities, authorized-delta connectivity, PCM13SMTR and PJ-324M footprints against the drawings
review.head: 1a2f31a5b599a2a9c92515bc94a440bb9482dd7e
review.record: https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-led-block/pull/24#pullrequestreview-5818088400 (first pass: review 5818084195 series; findings fixed in 1a2f31a)
review.verdict: approved for the schematic phase; not an approval of the board, routing or physical gates
open_physical_gates: PJ-324M pin functions (tip/ring/sleeve/normals) by TS/TRS continuity test of incoming parts
PJ-324M across-axis sign (drawing view direction) against the component side
PCM13SMTR body centring on the peg line (ASSUMED)

entries.reason: CV IN jack: accepted A7 redesign replaces the front-panel PJ-3582-B with the SOFNG PJ-324M right-angle threaded jack on the perpendicular controller. The mono CV contract is unchanged: tip to CV_THRU (J1/J2 tip-to-tip passive THRU), sleeve and ring to GND, normals unused.
entries.evidence_status: INFERRED pin functions (pinmap-a7-pj-324m): no manufacturer pin-function table exists; the SOFNG symbol and terminal depth were used. Not promoted. Incoming-part continuity test (tip/ring/sleeve/normals per pin) remains a physical gate.

entries.reason: CV THRU jack: accepted A7 redesign replaces the front-panel PJ-3582-B with the SOFNG PJ-324M right-angle threaded jack on the perpendicular controller. The mono CV contract is unchanged: tip to CV_THRU (J1/J2 tip-to-tip passive THRU), sleeve and ring to GND, normals unused.
entries.evidence_status: INFERRED pin functions (pinmap-a7-pj-324m): no manufacturer pin-function table exists; the SOFNG symbol and terminal depth were used. Not promoted. Incoming-part continuity test (tip/ring/sleeve/normals per pin) remains a physical gate.

entries.reason: Accepted A7 redesign moves ON/PROGRAM/CV from the front toggle to a PCB-side slide switch. Mode encoding is unchanged: grounded common, MODE_A/MODE_B pulled up by R9/R10. POS.1 (1-3) MODE_A=0,B=1 ON; POS.2 (2-3, terminal 2 open) 1,1 PROGRAM; POS.3 (3-4) 1,0 CV; 0,0 unreachable.
entries.evidence_status: Function table MIRROR (C&K document via LCSC, sha256 1c2ca483...). Land pattern read from the same drawing, unreviewed. JLC stock 0 (Q10); an in-stock alternate would be a new component_replaced review.
entries.carried_by: interface assertions sw.* / switch_positions / mode truth table
